About

Graduate in BSc International Business Management and MSc Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence. Professional background in business administration and operations, with international experience in financial reporting, HR administration, data management, and organisational support across London, Ibiza, Barcelona and Buenos Aires.

Dissertation · MSc 2026
2026
Data Anonymisation vs ML Fraud Detection in Blockchain Transactions 2026
Dissertation · MSc CS with AI · University of Wolverhampton · Supervisor: Prof. Daniyal Haider

Investigates how data anonymisation techniques (differential privacy, k-anonymity, synthetic data) impact the performance of ML fraud detection models on blockchain-style financial transaction data. Explores the fundamental tension between privacy-preserving transformations and predictive accuracy.

BlockchainFraud Detection AnonymisationPrivacy-Preserving ML Python
Explainable AI · 7CS075
2025
Explainable AI in Credit Risk: SHAP vs Counterfactual Explanations
7CS075 · Responsible AI · University of Wolverhampton

Comparative study of SHAP and counterfactual explanations (DiCE) applied to credit scoring models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost). SHAP provides feature-level attribution for auditors; counterfactuals offer actionable narratives for applicants. Evaluated across four dimensions: fidelity, actionability, fairness perception, and comprehensibility. Aligned with GDPR, EU AI Act, and FCA guidance.

SHAPCounterfactuals XGBoostDiCE Ethical AIGDPR

Data Science · 7CS078
2025
Credit Card Fraud Detection — Ensemble vs Linear Classifiers
7CS078 · Data Science · University of Wolverhampton

Applied Logistic Regression and Random Forest to 284,807 real transactions (0.17% fraud rate) from the ULB benchmark. SMOTE countered extreme class imbalance. Random Forest: F1 = 0.91, ROC-AUC = 0.957. Top predictors: V14, V17, V12 (atypical transaction timing and spending behaviour). Ethical AI considerations aligned with GDPR and PCI-DSS frameworks.
